title: Astra Air · Local AI Travel Assistant
label: FEATURED PROJECT / AGENTIC AI
description: A local airline-support demo built with Gradio, Ollama, and Qwen 3.5. The assistant selects read-only tools to search flights, look up a reservation, check flight status, and explain baggage rules using a fictional SQLite dataset.
details: Watch the 73-second walkthrough of multi-tool questions, visible tool results, and a declined cancellation. Recorded at 1.4× speed. Fictional demo data only; no real bookings, payments, or external inference API.

title: Old Man United
label: ALSO BUILT / LIVE APPLICATION
description: A mobile-friendly football team dashboard powered by Google Sheets. Explore season records, match results, player goals, clean sheets, and a Golden Boot leaderboard from one shared data source.
details: Validates incoming match data, handles tied rankings, and retains the last successful view if a refresh fails.
